name: sky.money USDS Flagship
oneLiner: skyMoneyUsdsFlagship is a Sky.money-curated Morpho lending vault over USDS; interest and losses change its share value, and exits depend on liquidity.
collateral: USDS held idle or supplied through Sky.money-curated Morpho lending markets
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares represent a pro-rata USDS-denominated claim on idle tokens and Morpho lender positions. Interest accrual and realized losses change the exchange rate. No liquidity adapter is configured, so ordinary redeem/withdraw pays from idle USDS; reaching lent USDS needs allocator deallocation or a holder forceDeallocate, which carries a 0.2% penalty and depends on market liquidity. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity.
